headline: Govt cancels Ad-din Hospital's license, instructs immediate patient transfer
summary: The government has revoked the license of Ad-din Medical College Hospital, directing the immediate transfer of all patients. The hospital has appealed the decision, while an opposition leader has criticized the move.
details: The government has cancelled the license of Ad-din Medical College Hospital, instructing authorities to swiftly transfer all patients. This directive follows the revocation of the hospital's operating license.
In response, Ad-din Hospital has appealed the government's decision. They are seeking permission to continue their services until a final resolution is reached.
A prominent opposition leader has publicly criticized the government's move to cancel Ad-din Hospital's license. The criticism highlights concerns regarding the impact on healthcare services.
caption:
Ad-din Medical College Hospital's license has been cancelled by the government, with instructions for immediate patient transfer.

The government has cancelled the license of Ad-din Medical College Hospital, instructing authorities to swiftly transfer all patients. This directive follows the revocation of the hospital's operating license.

In response, Ad-din Hospital has appealed the government's decision. They are seeking permission to continue their services until a final resolution is reached.

A prominent opposition leader has publicly criticized the government's move to cancel Ad-din Hospital's license. The criticism highlights concerns regarding the impact on healthcare services.

#AdDinHospital #Bangladesh #HealthNews #HospitalLicense #Healthcare

Source: Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
